walkthroughs.body_html:
Energy Resources — a core area of A-Level Environmental Science.

Working through it builds the schema you need: the key terms, how they connect, and how to use them together.

Energy Resources brings together several ideas you need to use as a set, not in isolation.

Lock in the vocabulary first, then practise pulling the ideas together to answer real questions.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Energy Resources.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.

mcqs.q: Why does renewable energy require energy storage solutions?
options: Solar and wind generation are intermittent - storage smooths out supply and demand.
Renewable energy can never meet demand.
Because they generate too much energy.
Common land in medieval Britain.

mcqs.q: Roughly what proportion of energy passes from one trophic level to the next?
options: 100 percent (everything transfers).
Because they generate too much energy.
About 10 percent.
About 50 percent.
